_comment: Course-wide snapshot years shared by every stage. fetch-base.mjs fills source_year and gap from historical-basemaps index.json using `rule` (nearest-not-after: latest base map not later than the calendar year; or nearest). A snapshot may pin a base year with source_override. The cartouche shows calendar year · base map source_year when they differ.

snapshots.override_reason: The 1400 map still shows the Mongol Great Khanate over China and has no Moscow; 1492 shows the Ming Empire and the Grand Duchy of Moscow. Trade-off: 1492 already shows Constantinople as Ottoman (fell 1453).
